verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਅਰੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਖਾਨਿ ਪਾਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਹਿਤਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau arog bhog bhogavai naanaa prakaar birathaava(n)t khaan paan ridhai na hitaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a healthy person eats many types of dishes and eatables but a sick man does not like eating any of them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਖੀ ਸਹਨ ਸੀਲ ਕੈ ਧੀਰਜ ਧੁਜਾ ਅਜਿਆ ਮੈ ਤਨਕ ਕਲੇਜੋ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise mahakhee sahan seel kai dheeraj dhujaa ajiaa mai tanak kalejo na samaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a buffalo, because of its tolerance is known to have great patience but a goat on the other hand does not have even a fraction of that patience.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਉਹਰੀ ਬਿਸਾਹੈ ਵੇਚੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਾਨਕਾਦਿ ਰੰਕ ਪੈ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਪਰੈ ਜੋਗ ਨ ਜੁਗਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jauharee bisaahai veche heeraa maanakaadh ra(n)k pai na raakhio parai jog na jugaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a jeweller trades in diamonds and precious stones but no valuable diamond can be kept with a pauper since he does not have the ability to keep such expensive item.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਪਚੁ ਅਪਰਚੇ ਦੁਸਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੫੦੫॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur parachai pavitr hai poojaa prasaadh apach aparache dhuseh dhukh paaviee ||505||

en.bdb: Similarly, a devotee who remains engaged in the service and remembrance of the Lord, eating the offerings and consecrated food for him is justified. But he who doesn't obey the command of the Guru suffers if he consumes the worship offerings. (505)
